changes.description: Resize any table column by dragging its header edge; widths are remembered and double-click resets
Sort assets by jumps to any system with the new Proximity picker, and filter or sort by region
Show which character installed each industry job, including corporation jobs
Fix Mutamarket sync not pricing abyssal modules after an API change
Keep table headers pinned while scrolling and stop cells wrapping onto extra lines
Remove the Beta label from the startup screen
Render large market order lists faster and keep columns aligned
Sort columns and resize panels with the keyboard
Update to Electron 45 and TypeScript 7, and migrate stored login data to Electron's new encryption API
